page.layout: One page of verse, single column, with a running head at the top and page number at top right; a catchword/signature mark "Qiij" at the foot right.

main_text.p: Multi vno veniunt nati de Patre: perennant
Sic annos hominum fecla per innumeros.
main_text.head: Mali bonis noxij.
main_text.p: Improbus esse probis quinam se monstret amicum,
En, clarum Testæ Petra propinqua facit.
Hæc illam fregit minimum collisa, breuíque:
Vnâ de testâ fragmina mille parit.
Vt morum paritas similes compingit in vnum,
Dissimiles morum disgregat imparitas.
Vnda fluit Rhodani, pernicibus hinc volat alis
Accipiter: velox & pede currit equus:
Præterit aura leuis: Notus aufugit: aret & herba:
Ros, stirps, flos, fructus, frons foliúmque cadunt.
Hæc vno fieri cernens punctóque locóque,
Dico, fugax tamen est, vt puto, vita magis.
main_text.head: Deo vocanti parere. Ἐπείθου θεῷ.
main_text.p: Dicebat Moses, QVOCVNQVE VOCAVERIS IBO,
O Devs, & duce te est inuia nulla via.
Inde ducum merito primus censetur, eíque
Nunquam figendus contribuetur honos.
Esse cupis summus? Fac numinis omnia ductu,
Illius iniussu suscipitóque nihil.
Oppositi fugient te sic peragente labores:
Et subito fient aspera plana tibi.

head.i: Haminantes in salinis tectis habitantes. ex Solino. Importuni sales.

main_text.p: In sale constructis Haminantes viuere tectis
Dicuntur: quibus est nil magis insipidum.

page.notes: Greek line "Ἐπείθου θεῷ" is partly printed as "E″πει&θῳ θεῷ"; read with doubt. Heading "Haminantes" is set in italic and its line is hyphenated "Im-portuni". The first verse line ends with a printed word "perennant" that appears to run into the margin; the marginal mark near "amicum" and "cadunt" is a printing flourish, not a note.
